name: Jest of the Hidden Path
body:
School: Conjuration (teleportation); Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: Instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You teleport a distance in feet equal to 5 times (1 + half your Wisdom modifier, rounded down). If you have at least 1 rank in the Knowledge (arcana) skill, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your next attack roll.
